purpose: Provider-neutral prompt catalog for arena sound cues (#1104). Data only: no runtime generation, no API calls, no audio yet.

promptTemplates.effect: Isolated original anime-style game sound effect: {recipe}. {duration} seconds. Fast clean onset; {tail}. Clear on phone speakers, controlled bass, no clipping. One effect only. No speech, no music, no background ambience, no recognizable TV/show recording.

voicePolicy: Voice is a separate asset class (#856): exact approved technique text, an original licensed performer/voice and a stated language. Never claim authentic anime-actor audio, never substitute browser TTS, never use copyrighted clips as generation references.
